Blightwood Field Journal

Recovered notes on the forest, its mutations, Subject 413, and equipment grown from mature spores.

Origin

An unknown researcher found spores inside the oldest trees. They restarted dead tissue by replacing damaged flesh with aggressive fungal growth.

The Escape

The experiments escaped containment. Infection entered the soil and roots until the forest became one enormous living organism.

Mutated Zombie

The most stable experiment. Human tissue and spores remain balanced. It alone can survive another concentrated dose of Zombie Virus.

Mutated Drowned

Mutations that fled into water adapted to breathe above and below it. Away from water, they may begin returning to a land form.

Puker

Its organs are pressurized chambers of poisonous spores. It spits infected matter at living creatures to spread Blightwood sickness.

Bloater

A failed spore-storage vessel swollen with gas and decay. It explodes when threatened. Lightning makes the reaction far stronger.

Charged Zombie

Lightning struck during mutation. The fungal network trapped its energy, creating a faster and stronger infected creature.

Flying Zombie

Not a natural mutation. Subject 413 tears small bodies from the network and throws them as living weapons.

Subject 413

The final controlled specimen was meant to command the entire infection. It never awakened because it lacked one final virus dose.

Awakening 413

Find a Mutated Zombie. Use a Zombie Vial directly on it. The vessel becomes helpless during its roughly 28-second transformation.

Recovered Voice

You found the vessel. You carried my virus into the heart of the Blightwood. You have completed my work.

Final Recording

Subject 413 is awake.

And Subject 413 is hungry.

Mature Spore Pod

Shapeless: Iron Ingot + Rotten Flesh + Mutated Flesh + Raw Blightspore. This pod is the core material for Blightwood gear.

Armor Recipes

Use Mature Spore Pods in normal helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots patterns at a crafting table.

Tool Recipes

Use Mature Spore Pods with sticks in normal sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, and hoe patterns.

Seeds and Timber

One Raw Blightspore makes 2 Blightspore Seeds. One Blightwood Log or Stripped Log makes 4 Blightwood Planks.

Project Warning

Subject 413 commands nearby mutations and can call more from the forest. Do not allow the network to gather around it.
